title: Bug: test_bgp_session_flap.py failed on v6 topo
author: markx-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

test_bgp_session_flap.py failed on v6 topo.
No v4 neighbors on v6 topos, so it always consumes 0 memory.
Memory comparison with baseline memory fails because less than sign is used.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run the test on v6 topo

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

The test should pass
